name: Shiny night Drop
source:
Eating the konpeito I got from an angel makes me very happy.
My body becomes light and feathery, and I can fly to the sky.

In a twinkling starry universe, I enjoy another day of chatting with my cute friends...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/24321]Freem![/url]]
